name: GLM 5.2
summary: A current-endpoint view that separates GLM 5's architecture report from GLM 5.2's reviewed artifact and deployment claims.

stages.title: Token sequence
stages.summary: Input is aggregated without claiming an unfrozen tokenizer or context configuration.

stages.title: Dynamic sparse attention
stages.summary: DSA is grounded in the GLM 5 architecture report.

stages.title: IndexShare deployment path
stages.summary: The release name IndexShare is shown alongside, not substituted for, the linked IndexCache paper's cross-layer index reuse scope.

stages.title: Sparse MoE path
stages.summary: Sparse routing is aggregated without freezing expert counts or layer placement.

stages.title: Multi-token prediction
stages.summary: MTP is represented as a prediction and serving mechanism, not as a claim that every decoded token is accepted.

stages.title: GLM 5.2 topology not frozen
stages.summary: Exact 5.2 dimensions and serving assumptions remain behind the course-local source freeze.
